name: Blanton Museum of Art
address: 200 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Austin, TX 78712
hours_summary: Tue–Sun · 10 AM – 5 PM (Sun from 1 PM) · closed Mon
tagline: UT's university art museum. Ellsworth Kelly's Austin is the pilgrimage piece.
description: The University of Texas at Austin's art museum, with one of the largest university collections in the country — Renaissance and Baroque European painting, modern American art, and the strongest Latin American collection in the United States. The grounds include Ellsworth Kelly's Austin, a standalone stone building he designed in the last years of his life.

tips.text: Free every Thursday, courtesy of the museum's membership program.
Ellsworth Kelly's Austin is a separate building on the grounds — check the ticket covers both.

highlights.item: Works by Tarsila do Amaral, Diego Rivera, João Câmara
Luca Giordano, Nicolas Poussin, Peter Paul Rubens
